subject: Risk Gate Binder: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA checklist for evaluation close
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Quinn <emma.quinn@mettlebank.com>, MettleBank Security <security@mettlebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Risk Gate Binder: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA checklist for evaluation close

Emma / security team —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching a single "risk gate binder" that collates the SOC 2 attestation, our SIG/CAIQ responses, and the current DPA redline. My goal is to keep the MAP simple and actionable so your engineering and legal teams can sign off without follow-up rounds. Key ask: can you confirm the target close date for procurement/executive sign-off on your side (we suggested Dec 15 in partner ops, but open to your cadence)?

Proposed MAP checkpoints (high-level):
- A: SOC 2 attestation + evidence (control narratives + scan summary) — deliver by Dec 3
- B: SIG/CAIQ responses with prioritized triage for any Critical / High gaps — deliver full sheet Dec 3, priority answers 48 hours
- C: DPA final redline & countersign — aim to have legal agree on core carveouts by Dec 7
- D: Data retention/residency confirmation (prod vs backups vs test) — explicit tiers in the DPA annex

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf (attestation + summary), SIG-CAIQ_Responses_MettleBank_v2.xlsx (working draft), DPA_Redline_MettleBank.docx (tracked changes).

Open items we flagged in the binder for clarification from your side:
1) Retention horizon for fraud logs / audit logs — do you require >5 years?
2) KMS / HSM requirements for long-term archival keys?
3) Any in-scope SaaS connectors requiring EU residency specifically?

Next steps: if you confirm the Dec 15 target we will lock the MAP and escalate any legal gaps to our Director of Legal (Kimberly) to accelerate.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Success (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
attachments: [Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf (pdf), SIG-CAIQ_Responses_MettleBank_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), DPA_Redline_MettleBank.docx (docx)]

From: Emma Quinn <emma.quinn@mettlebank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, MettleBank Security <security@mettlebank.com>
Cc: TrustAudit <audit@trustaudit.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Risk Gate Binder: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA checklist for evaluation close

Tessa —

Appreciate the consolidated binder. A few clarifying Qs from our security and procurement teams before we confirm the Dec 15 runway:

1) Retention: our baseline requirement for audit-grade logs is 7 years. Can Redwood support tiered retention (90 days hot, 3 years warm, 7 years cold) with documented deletion procedures?
2) Encryption: confirm whether customer data is encrypted at rest with customer-controlled keys (KMS/HSM), and whether key escrow is possible for EU-residency vaulting.
3) SIG/CAIQ: TrustAudit will run an independent pass on the responses. Can you flag any answers that remain "operational mitigations" vs implemented controls so we can prioritize?
4) DPA redline: legal will need a tracked copy we can iterate on — we received your doc but will send a few carveouts (mainly around indemnity and subcontractor flow-down).

We will aim to get an executive decision tentatively the week of Dec 13, but legal needs the DPA redline by Dec 7 to allow internal counsel review. For the SOC 2 attestation, please confirm whether the attestation covers both Redwood hosted and Dedicated environments or just hosted.

Emma Quinn
VP, Platform Risk & Security
MettleBank
security@mettlebank.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Risk Gate Binder: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA checklist for evaluation close

Folks — following up with proposed responses / timeline to feed back to MettleBank:

1) Retention tiers: Redwood supports configurable retention tiers. Proposed default for the MAP: hot (90d), warm (3y), cold (7y) for audit logs. We will add explicit language in the DPA Annex A.
2) KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations for Dedicated customers; for Hosted customers we offer envelope encryption with customer KMS (bring-your-own-key) for production. EU vaulting for key material is available on request (requires provisioning window ~7 business days).
3) SOC 2 scope: the 2026 SOC 2 Type II attestation covers our Hosted API and Redwood Console services (production inference path). Dedicated pools and private deployments are covered by a separate attestation; we can provide the Dedicated controls summary on request (timeline ~5 business days to assemble).
4) SIG/CAIQ status: the attached spreadsheet has the working-state answers — I’ve colored rows: RED = requires engineering change, AMBER = procedural/legal mitigation, GREEN = implemented. We’ll mark any "operational mitigation" cells in AMBER. Priority: please ask TrustAudit to focus on RED rows, we will treat those as gating items.
5) DPA redline: Kimberly, can you escalate to Legal and aim to have core carveouts agreed by Dec 7? If legal needs an exceptions matrix, we’ll publish one for Procurement.

Actionable timeline we propose to present to MettleBank:
- Dec 3: Provide SOC 2 evidence packet + finalized SIG sheet (priority Qs answered)
- Dec 7: Legal convergence on DPA core carveouts (redline exchanged)
- Dec 11: MettleBank exec review (they indicated tentative availability)
- Dec 15: Target countersign / purchase order trigger

Attachments referenced: [SIG-CAIQ_Responses_MettleBank_v2.xlsx (updated), Redwood_Dedicated_Control_Summary.pdf (stub)]

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Partner, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Quinn <emma.quinn@mettlebank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, TrustAudit <audit@trustaudit.co>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 16:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Risk Gate Binder: SOC 2 / SIG/CAIQ / DPA checklist for evaluation close

Neha / Tessa —

Thanks for the detail and the proposed timeline. Our security team will run TrustAudit through the RED/AMBER rows; we will request a short explainer session for any RED items (30–45 min technical deep-dive).

Legal will aim to deliver DPA counter-redlines by Dec 7. Two quick asks before we move to exec review:
- Please confirm the data deletion policy for non-prod/test environments (we need a written process for scrub and reprovisioning).
- Can you provide the Dedicated control summary PDF (you referenced Redwood_Dedicated_Control_Summary.pdf) — even a stub is fine for procurement to see separation of scope.

We will target an internal exec decision window Dec 11–12; if procurement has the signed DPA and the SOC/SIG artefacts are acceptable, we’ll be ready to move to PO. I’ll loop in procurement separately.
